title: Banco Master / Vorcaro ↔ Moraes ↔ Mendonça STF crisis
overview: PF forensic report (218pp, 27 Aug) documented 52 one-way WhatsApp messages (30 Oct–17 Nov 2025) from banker Daniel Vorcaro to a contact saved as 'Alexandre de Moraes BRASÍLIA', plus a R$3M/month contract between Vorcaro's Banco Master and Barci de Moraes Advogados (Moraes's family firm; metadata lists 'Ministro Alexandre de Moraes' as last editor). Justice Mendonça's September unsealing triggered Moraes's counter-accusations of procedural abuse; Fachin centralized the matter with 5-business-day manifestações and a postponed plenary (late September). Calibrated verdict so far: proximity scandal confirmed; judicial misconduct unproven on both sides.
